test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: At what rate of compound interest per annum, a sum of Rs. 20000 becomes Rs. 23152.50 in 1 year 6 months compounded half-yearly?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Amount** to **Principal** for 3 half-years = 23152.50 : 20000 = 9261 : 8000

For 1 half-year, take the cube root: ³√9261 : ³√8000 = 21 : 20

**Half-yearly Rate** = (21 − 20)/20 × 100 = 5%

**Annual Rate** = 5% × 2 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10% per annum.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹20000

**Amount (A)** = ₹23152.50

**Time (t)** = 1 year 6 months = 1.5 years

**Compounding:** Half-yearly

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6fcaa1b059d399639d3e94ed37395e92d996de517b56bc04a22370cf7e42c18.png] 

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where r = **half-yearly rate** and n = **number of half-years**.

**Calculations:**

⇒ n = 1.5 × 2 = 3 periods

⇒ 23152.50 = 20000(1 + r/100)³

⇒ 23152.50 / 20000 = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ 231525 / 200000 = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ 9261 / 8000 = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ (21 / 20)³ = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ 21 / 20 = 1 + r/100

⇒ r / 100 = 21/20 − 1 = 1 / 20

⇒ r = 100 / 20 = 5% (Half-yearly rate)

⇒ **Annual Rate** = 2 × r = 2 × 5% = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10% per annum.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Half-yearly Compounding Rule

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the annual **rate** is divided by 2 (r = R/2) and the **time** is multiplied by 2 (n = 2 × T).

Quarterly Compounding

For quarterly compounding, the rate is divided by 4 (r = R/4) and the number of periods is n = 4 × T.

Effective Rate of Interest

The **effective rate** for two periods of r% is given by the successive formula: r + r + (r × r)/100.
